decisions.reason: Retaining gallery hover animations does not change the gallery's browsing mode, tabs, or content organization.
The pricing-layout decision is independently stated in the same message and is already represented; the hover-animation change causes no additional pricing-state change.
The decision to retain hover animations does not alter the homepage buttons or their destinations.
Hover-animation behavior does not affect the one-time pricing model or the visibility of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
The source decision concerns gallery hover effects and does not change the homepage design direction, image emphasis, or overlay styling.
Retaining gallery hover effects does not change the sitewide requirement for highly visual, image-focused pages.
The hover-animation decision does not alter itemized pricing coverage, transparency, classification, or layout.
Gallery hover effects are independent of package counts, square-footage categories, and package pricing values.
Retaining gallery hover animations does not change the rule that each service must have a corresponding image.
The source resolves mobile hover effects for gallery items; it does not necessarily modify the distinct basic animation requested for the homepage gallery.
The gallery hover decision does not affect the pricing-area navigation entry or its destination.
The hover-effect decision does not change the CMS, hosting provider, domain provider, or control-panel configuration.
